messages:
mia: Hey folks — I pushed a draft release note for the new cache-first routing + default prefix caching behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1742. Can reviewers pls sanity-check wording and the Known Issues section?

sam: skimmed it. overall good. a couple of quick nits: 1) the paragraph that says "enabled by default for Dedicated" — that’s only after feature-flag flip; suggest "default for newly created Dedicated pools after FF rollout". 2) remove the phrase "always reduces latency" — it trades latency vs token cost in some tail cases.

nina: also found a broken SDK snippet on the Python example page — lines 12-15 use an old param name `dedupe_keys`. API now expects `dedup_keys`. small patch below.

nina: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/rt-7b', input='Summarize this...', dedup_keys=['id'])
```

sam: exact — thanks. please also update the JS snippet where we do `config.dedupe` -> `config.dedup`.

oliver: I can open a followup PR to sweep SDK snippets across docs for that param rename. Will grep for `dedupe` and `dedupe_keys` and run through examples.

mia: thanks. two other Known Issues to call out (from runtime): 1) streaming truncation on some quantized kernels at 8k+ seq lengths (workaround: set `streaming=false` or use non-quantized model variant), 2) console preview for rollout state can show stale latency numbers for ~5m during autoscale window.

sam: can you add short code/UX examples for the workaround? e.g. Python + Console note.

mia: added quick examples in the draft: 
- Python: `client.generate(..., streaming=False)` 
- Console: toggle -> Model settings -> disable prefix caching for this route (or pin to non-quantized variant)

nina: running linkchecker now (linkcheck script: `scripts/docs/linkcheck.sh`). will post results here shortly. found one internal redirect to stale image on the feature banner.

docs-bot: Deploy preview built: https://deploy.preview.redwood.sh/1742 (staging). Diff: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1742/files

oliver: I’ll smoke-test the sample app (examples/rt-caching) against the preview and validate the SDK snippets after nina's linkcheck.

nina: linkcheck finished — 3 warnings, 1 broken image (banner), 2 anchor misses in the changelog generator section. I raised issue #287 in the docs tracker for the image and added inline comment on the PR.

mia: great — I'll update the PR with wording tweaks from sam, include the Known Issues bullets, patch the Python/JS snippets (or accept oliver's followup if he prefers), and replace the banner image. planning to merge after docowner signoff and a quick smoke test from oliver.

sam: please add a one-line whats-new blurb for the newsletter: "Cache-first routing and default prefix caching to reduce token costs; see migration notes and known issues."

mia: done, pushed `whatsnew` blurb to PR description. final ask: if anyone still has lingering examples to add (reranking or embeddings edge-case), drop them as PR comments. merging target EOD if no blockers. :thumbsup:

oliver: will test by 16:30 and report pass/fail.

nina: will re-run linkcheck after the image fix and post green.

mia: thanks all — really appreciate the quick sweep.
